title: One personal-data inventory with full provenance
description:
Personal-data matching runs once per repository; raw-hit, mention and data-item projections derive from that one inventory.

Two defects to close together:

1. `scanRepoByManifestLayers` claims in a comment that "personal-data matching runs at most once" while the body calls `collectPersonalDataFindings` up to three times, each running its own `ingestFileSystem` and `matchPiiSignalsInFiles`.
2. `hitsToDataItemFindings` collapses hits by key and keeps a **single arbitrary location**, chosen by `hit.evidence.filePath < existing.filePath` — lexicographically first. Every other supporting location is discarded, which makes evidence-strength matching arbitrary under one-to-one assignment.

Findings must preserve all provenance locations. Fixing only the gold-side consolidation while the finding still carries one lexicographically-chosen path leaves the defect in place.
